description: Swedish serverless inference provider for open-weight language, embedding, reranking, and speech-to-text models on European infrastructure.
prompt_training_notes: Berget states that prompts and responses are never stored or used for training.
regional_pricing_notes: Berget publishes one EUR-denominated serverless price list; subscription plans alter included credit rather than model list prices.

sources.notes: Official current model inventory, identifiers, context limits, modalities, availability labels, and EUR list prices.
Official OpenAPI specification documents bearer authentication and chat, embeddings, rerank, transcription, and model-discovery endpoints.
Official quickstart confirms the OpenAI-compatible base URL and Stockholm execution with data remaining in Europe.
Berget AI's official contact page states that Berget AI was founded in Sweden.
Provider metadata and model support enrichment; not a Phaseo-routable offer.

verification.notes: Provider metadata, API surface, residency, retention, and current catalogue verified against Berget's official documentation and OpenAPI specification.
